rows.grounds: predicate identifying the nature of the individual soul
predicate equated with light as the soul's nature
subject identified with light and reality

items.question: Is the individual soul inherently identical with eternal light and ultimate reality?
premises: The individual soul is ultimate reality.
The individual soul is inherently eternal.
items.inference: Therefore the individual soul is inherently eternal light and ultimate reality.
items.plain_english: O beautiful-hipped one, the individual soul is itself eternal light, the ultimate reality.
